locations.name: City of Surrey Truck Parking (17768 96 Avenue)
locations.source_note: City of Surrey commercial truck parking site at 17768 96 Avenue (Anniedale-Tynehead), Hwy 15 / Pacific Highway corridor. City news and corporate reports advance this City-owned lot (~41 truck spaces) under Temporary Use Permit / licence with Prudential Transportation. Pin matches the Phase A Surrey stand-in coordinates.

locations.name: Husky / Esso Travel Centre (1148 Pacific Street)
locations.source_note: Husky/Esso travel centre at 1148 Pacific Street, Prince George BC (Hwy 97 corridor). Truck-stop directories list ~20–25 truck parking spaces, diesel, and 24/7 amenities. Stand-in fuel/parking pin for ALCAN Phase A through-freight (no CA domestic career board).

locations.name: Husky (1700 Alaska Highway)
locations.source_note: Husky fuel at 1700 Alaska Highway, Dawson Creek BC, near Mile 0 of the Alaska Highway. City pin is the Alaska Highway Mile 0 milepost on 102 Avenue. Stand-in fuel/parking for ALCAN Phase A Mile 0 (through-freight only; no CA domestic career board).

locations.name: Smith Fuel Services (9516 78 Street)
locations.source_note: Smith Fuel Services commercial fuel at 9516 78 Street / Northern Lights Drive, Fort St. John BC, on the Alaska Highway approach. Stand-in fuel/parking pass-through north of Dawson Creek Mile 0 for ALCAN Phase A through-freight (no CA domestic career board).
